## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from APA publisher pages (apa.org/pubs/journals/neu) and domain knowledge of APA Division 40 (Society for Clinical Neuropsychology) editorial culture. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Low-Medium — paradigm-unified clinical neuroscience |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — neurodiversity, aging × neuropsychology, cultural neuropsychology |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Clinical neuropsychology — TBI, stroke, dementia, neurodegenerative disorders, neurodevelopmental disorders, cognitive rehabilitation, neuropsychological assessment |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **clinical neuropsychology contribution** — brain-behavior relationships in clinical populations or cognitive assessment.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure cognitive neuroscience redirected to JoCN; pure clinical psychology redirected to JCCP.

| Autoethnography | 0 | Outside scope |
| Theoretical / Conceptual | 2 | With empirical evidence |
| Mixed methods | 2 | Quantitative-dominant |
| Meta-analysis | 5 | Welcomed |
| Neuroimaging × clinical | 5 | Distinctive strength |
| Neuropsychological assessment | 5 | Core method |

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

Reviewers from clinical-neuropsychology community — APA Division 40 (Society for Clinical Neuropsychology), INS (International Neuropsychological Society) overlap. Common demands: "Clinical significance?", "Brain-behavior specificity?", "Assessment validity?".

| Aspect | Detail | Evidence |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Dominant tradition** | Clinical neuropsychology — APA Division 40 |
| **Reviewer competence variance** | Medium |
| **Quantitative mindset bias on qualitative work?** | Yes (strong) |
| **Discourse community signals (editorial board)** | APA Division 40 / INS affiliated |

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without clinical neuropsychology focus
- AI use without disclosure per APA policy
- Pure cognitive neuroscience without clinical population (consider JoCN)
- Pure clinical psychology without neuropsychological assessment (consider JCCP)

### Soft Tax

Low for clinical-neuropsychology tradition authors.

### Best Suited For

- TBI, stroke, dementia neuropsychological research
- Neurodevelopmental disorder neuropsychology
- Cognitive rehabilitation studies
- Neuropsychological test development and validation
- Clinical neuroimaging research
- Cultural neuropsychology

### Not Recommended For

- Pure cognitive neuroscience (consider JoCN)
- Pure clinical psychology (consider JCCP)
- Pure qualitative work
- Theoretical-only without clinical application

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Clinical and Experimental Neuropsychology](./journal-of-clinical-and-experimental-neuropsychology.md) | T&F clinical-neuropsychology peer |
| 2 | [Archives of Clinical Neuropsychology](./archives-of-clinical-neuropsychology.md) | NAN-affiliated clinical neuropsychology |
| 3 | [Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience](./journal-of-cognitive-neuroscience.md) | If neuroscience-mechanism dominates over clinical |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JoCN as "too clinical / not cognitive-mechanism," Neuropsychology is the APA Division 40 home for clinical brain-behavior research.
